text:
alana-sec: FYI: vendor disclosure for an XML/metadata importer bug in our federation helper library. Tracked internally as CVE-2026-8888. Potential remote metadata fetch + entity expansion when auto-import is enabled.

alana-sec: Impact: Redwood Private installs with `federation.import=true` and Dedicated clusters using the legacy metadata-cache sync are at risk. Hosted customers unaffected.

deploy-bot: Created ticket SEC-12021 and attached initial triage doc: https://tickets.redwood-internal/SEC-12021 :rotating_light: 

mike-prod: How many customers are we talking about? Need to coordinate CS outreach.

alana-sec: Inventory: 11 Dedicated tenants + 8 Private customers with import enabled. List linked in SEC-12021.

ravi-sre: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable auto-import/configured sync, 2) publish patched image `redwood/fed-importer:5.2.1-hotfix`, 3) require rotation of any auto-ingested trust certs created in the last 60 days.

alana-sec: Timeline proposal: T+1h disable import org-wide for affected tenants; T+6h canary with patched image; T+24-48h full rollout; T+72h customer cert rotation window.

sre-oncall: I'm on the oncall rotation, will help run the disable and watch auth traces.

ravi-sre: Disable commands: Dedicated control plane:```bash
kubectl -n redwood-system patch configmap federation-settings -p '{"data":{"import_enabled":"false"}}'
```
Private Helm:```bash
helm upgrade --install redwood-private ./chart --set federation.importEnabled=false
```

deploy-bot: Patch images built and signed: `redwood/fed-importer:5.2.1-hotfix` and `redwood/fed-importer:5.2.1-hotfix-onprem`. CI/CD canary staged.

yara-cs: I'll draft customer advisory. Need a short opt-in for us to perform the patch and a fallback for customers that manage their own on-prem upgrades.

kevin-legal: Please include expedited review contact and language for regulated accounts (SOC2/FedRAMP). Also confirm were not asserting any confirmed exfiltration in customer comms.

alana-sec: Agreed  we'll say: "No evidence of exfiltration to date; proactive mitigation recommended."

ravi-sre: Canary policy: roll to 2% low-traffic pools -> monitor auth failures & unexpected external fetches for 90 minutes -> 20% -> 100%. Rollback uses previous tag.

sre-oncall: I'll set alerts to watch for spikes in `saml.fetch.external` logs and `auth.fail` for the next 6 hours.

yara-cs: Customer copy draft (short):

yara-cs: "Security advisory: CVE-2026-8888   Redwood released a patch for a metadata importer vulnerability affecting Private and some Dedicated deployments that use automated federation metadata import. We recommend disabling automated import immediately and applying the provided patch. If you want Redwood to apply the update, reply with your account ID and preferred maintenance window."

kevin-legal: Add a sentence for regulated customers about the audit trail and our offer to perform certificate rotation on their behalf.

alana-sec: Runbook for engineers: https://wiki.redwood-internal/runbooks/fed-importer-cve-8888. Add that link to the ticket and customer coms where appropriate.

mike-prod: CS: please include an opt-out if a customer cannot accept our patch (we'll document risk and offer guidance). Tag me for accounts with active P0s.

ravi-sre: Action items: Ravi (SRE) disable import now for high-risk tenants; Deploy-bot will start canary in 6h; Yara draft customer emails; Kevin legal review customer wording; Alana coordinate post-incident summary.

deploy-bot: SEC-12021 updated: disable step executed for tenants: tenant-101, tenant-204, tenant-309. Canary scheduled at 2026-06-15T18:00Z.

sre-oncall: Running telemetry query to find `entityDescriptor` external fetches in the last 120 days. Posting results to SEC-12021.

alana-sec: We'll produce an internal incident blurb once we have the telemetry sweep. Expect an internal post within 5 business days. If you see any evidence of exploitation, escalate to #incidents and tag me immediately.

ravi-sre: One more note  for on-prem installs we also have a helper script to clean cached metadata: `scripts/clear-fed-cache.sh --path /var/lib/redwood/fed-cache` — recommend running after patch.

yara-cs: Sending draft to CS now. Will CC legal & product for regulated templates.

alana-sec: Thanks team. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :shield:
